instruction: Turn on the video transform filter and mirror the picture horizontally (left-right), just for display — no need to export anything.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'video-filter', default: '' } ] }); return data[0]; }
async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'transform-type', default: '90' } ] }); return data[0]; }
